sentences.text:
This is an application seeking anticipatory bail filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.
The petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.996/2025 of Areekode Police Station.

The offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable under Sections 126(2) and 118(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
3.

The prosecution case as narrated in Annexure A2 order, reads thus:
" At about 2:40 P.M. on 15.10.2025 at the Areekode bus stand, the accused due to his prior animosity to the defacto complainant because the accused believed that the defacto complainant told his friends to the alleged relationship of the accused with the sister of the friend of the defacto complainant, the accused entered into the bus stand in which the defacto complainant was in charge as the conductor and wrongfully restrained the defacto complainant, slapping him and beat him on his back and attacked 2025:KER:94633 the defacto complainant on his forehead with a steel ring.
Thus, the accused is alleged to have committed the aforementioned offences..
"[SIC]

4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
5.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is innocent of the allegations levelled against him.
He has been implicated in the crime due to the previous animosity.
6. The learned Public prosecutor opposed the bail application contending that the petitioner has criminal antecedents.

7. The Case Diary reveals that the petitioner is accused in the following crimes:-
1. Crime No.160/2019 of Areekode Police Station, registered under Sections 376,
376(2), 376 (II), 4 r/w 3 of POCSO Act.

2. Crime No.468/2025 of Kozhikode Medical Collage Police Station, registered under Sections 281, 125(a), 125 (b) of BNS.
3. Crime No.763/2025 of Mukkom Police Station, registered under Sections 281,
324(3), 296 (b), 2025:KER:94633 351(2) of BNS.
4. Crime No.1375/2023 of Areekode Police Station, registered under Section 118(a) of KP Act

. 
5. Crime No.1115/2024 of Kozhikode Medical Collage Police Station, registered under Sections 281, 125(a) of BNS.
6. Crime No.1724/2023 of Kozhikode City Traffic Police Station, registered under Section 279 of IPC and Sec.119 and 184(A) of MV Act

. 
8. The prosecution has placed credible materials to establish the involvement of the petitioner in the crime.
Therefore, I am of the view that the petitioner is not entitled to the benefits contemplated in Section 482 of the BNSS.
The Bail Application stands dismissed.
